SPY.title: Small Caps Soar, Apple Slips, Treasury Yields Fall On Trump Day 2: What's Driving Markets Tuesday?
SPY.description: The Russell 2000 index led the market, rallying 1.7%, while other large-cap indices trailed behind. Apple Inc. plunged 4.3% after a downgrade, and Treasury yields fell as investors were convinced by Trump's pledges on inflation control and lower federal spending.
SPY.author: Piero Cingari
